title: Fix pre-existing clippy -D warnings failures in reader crate
description: cargo clippy -p stoa-reader --lib -- -D warnings fails with 7 pre-existing issues not related to recent changes: redundant closures in post/lmdb_store.rs (lines 45,57,68,86), needless-range-loop in post/injection.rs:93, explicit-auto-deref in session/lifecycle.rs (lines 74,202). These were present before the rate-limit hardening commits. Fix them to get clean clippy gate.
